# mishka_chelekom

You want ready-made components that are your own code, not a stylesheet's class names.

**Before:** every card, timeline and navbar written by hand over `core_components.ex`, or dressed in class names whose markup and behaviour are still yours to write.

**After:** `<.card>`, `<.timeline>`, `<.carousel>` and the rest are function components in `lib/<app>_web/components/`, generated by Mishka Chelekom and yours to edit — all 74 of them, or the ones `--components` names — with `--no-daisy` when they are to be the project's one set.

**Not for:** a project that keeps daisyUI as its component set — the two style some of the same class names, and one of them has to give.
